summary: The list lookup returns its input unchanged, used with with_list when you don't want transformation.
questions: How do I loop over a list without flattening nested lists?

answer_card.title: list lookup (with_list)
answer_card.answer_md: The `list` lookup is essentially a no-op: it returns what it's given. Use `with_list` when you don't want items transformed or flattened.
